test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 1 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A said to B, ‘I am a wise granddaughter of my maternal grandmother X and though I have only one sister, you are the sister of my maternal uncle’. B told A, ‘Though I am married, I don’t have any children but my husband C has a brother D and E is D’s son.’ How is X related to C?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given:

1) A said to B, ‘I am a wise granddaughter of my maternal grandmother X and though I have only one sister, you are the sister of my maternal uncle’.

As it cannot be determined B's relation with A, so B can either the mother or maternal aunt of A.

Case 1) B is the mother of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2488f37e9dd700257c37542819b9c811cc0b6aa79924ea0d8927ab51cd15b3a6.png] 

Case 2) B is the maternal aunt of A.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/841178ce09ce3659faf9fb6fb17e58d158a56a5657b73634c58772bce393fe61.png] 

2) B told A, ‘Though I am married, I don’t have any children but my husband C has a brother D and E is D’s son.’ 

As B doesn't have any children, therefore case 1 is eliminated.

Case 2)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/efde3c12bfc819820a6fa05eb3e236abedb3c819fcc299b7850766ed464c971d.png] 

Thus, X is C's mother-in-law or wife's mother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
